title: SBS Zoom sessions cancelled
summary: We've cancelled the SBS Zoom sessions and are thinking about what else we might do.
content:
We've cancelled the Small Business System fortnightly Zoom sessions. Attendance was sparse, and for something that took so much mental energy they weren't earning their keep.

If you're an SBS member you can always book a 1:1 session with me. Email me for the link to my calendar.

I haven't given up on the idea of open/public Zoom sessions. We've tried a few formats over the years and nothing's quite stuck. We'll continue to experiment.
